cond_0001.intro: The incumbent will provide technical and scientific expertise in the research and development of plasma derived or recombinant proteins or in support of the manufacture of plasma derived or recombinant proteins. The incumbent is a technically competent professional who uses their expertise to assist in executing a compliant stability program to support licensed products and developmental projects, ensuring the on-going quality and safety of marketed material, in addition to implementing solutions to a variety of company related objectives. Incumbent will be responsible for providing stability support for products (marketed and/or development), generation of stability protocols and reports, reviewing and analyzing incoming data, and authoring Stability documents in support of Regulatory submissions. He/she may participate in interdepartmental product project teams and present stability data to peer and management groups. In addition, he/she will work in partnership with Manufacturing/Technical Operations/Supply Chain/Research and Development to conduct and resolve investigations of unexpected stability data and trends. Additional responsibilities may be assigned by department manager.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
With supervision, develops action plans in support of departmental goals.

Capable of reporting project activities to immediate supervisor and within group meetings.

Independently applies sound scientific principles in development of solutions to complex technical problems within area of expertise.
Applies professional principles, established techniques, and [Company name masked]'s policies and procedures in completion of job tasks.
Assists in the design of scientifically complex experiments.
Executes and interprets results independently.
Position requires great organizational and experimental design skills.
Knowledge of the Regulatory guidelines, licensed product lines, routine test methods, and developmental projects related to stability studies.
Demonstrated ability in technical report writing and attention to detail.
Knowledge of site systems (such as SAP) to perform stability study related activities.
Able to communicate effectively and promptly supporting department objectives and management decisions.
Collects, reviews, and analyzes stability data.
Technical knowledge sufficient to conduct and resolve stability investigations is expected.
Provide support for products (marketed and/or developmental).
Provide stability support for the research and development of plasma derived proteins.
Author stability reports/documents to support the annual product reviews and regulatory submissions under direction of supervisor.

cond_0067.intro: The incumbent will provide technical and scientific expertise in the research and development of plasma derived or recombinant proteins or in support of the manufacture of plasma derived or recombinant proteins. The incumbent is a technically competent professional who uses their expertise to assist in executing a compliant stability program to support licensed products and developmental projects, ensuring the on-going quality and safety of marketed material, in addition to implementing solutions to a variety of company related objectives. Incumbent will be responsible for providing stability support for products (marketed and/or development), generation of stability protocols and reports, reviewing and analyzing incoming data, and authoring Stability documents in support of Regulatory submissions. In addition, he/she will work in partnership with Manufacturing/Technical Operations/Supply Chain/Research and Development to conduct and resolve investigations of unexpected stability data and trends. Additional responsibilities may be assigned by department manager. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of stability data and how it connects to regulatory and product quality requirements.

cond_0110.intro: The incumbent will provide technical and scientific expertise in the research and development of plasma derived or recombinant proteins or in support of the manufacture of plasma derived or recombinant proteins. The incumbent is a technically competent professional who uses their expertise to assist in executing a compliant stability program to support licensed products and developmental projects, ensuring the on-going quality and safety of marketed material, in addition to implementing solutions to a variety of company related objectives. Incumbent will be responsible for providing stability support for products (marketed and/or development), generation of stability protocols and reports, reviewing and analyzing incoming data, and authoring Stability documents in support of Regulatory submissions. He/she may participate in interdepartmental product project teams and present stability data to peer and management groups. In addition, he/she will work in partnership with Manufacturing/Technical Operations/Supply Chain/Research and Development to conduct and resolve investigations of unexpected stability data and trends. Additional responsibilities may be assigned by department manager.

cond_0116.intro: We are looking for a Senior Associate Stability Research Scientist II to join our team. In this role, you will own technical and scientific work in the research and development of plasma derived or recombinant proteins, or in direct support of their manufacture. You will take accountability for executing a compliant stability program supporting licensed products and developmental projects, ensuring the ongoing quality and safety of marketed material, and driving solutions to a range of company objectives. You will be responsible for delivering stability support for marketed and/or development products, generating stability protocols and reports, analyzing incoming data, and authoring stability documents for regulatory submissions. You may lead participation in interdepartmental product project teams and present stability data to peer and management groups. You will also work in direct partnership with Manufacturing, Technical Operations, Supply Chain, and Research and Development to conduct and resolve investigations of unexpected stability data and trends. Additional responsibilities may be assigned by the department manager.

cond_0117.intro: We are looking for a Senior Associate Research Scientist II to join our team. In this role, you will work alongside colleagues to support the research and development of plasma derived or recombinant proteins, or help support their manufacture. You will contribute to a compliant stability program that supports licensed products and developmental projects, helping to ensure the ongoing quality and safety of marketed material. Working together with cross-functional partners, you will help implement solutions to a range of objectives. You will share responsibility for stability support, generating protocols and reports, reviewing and analyzing incoming data, and co-authoring stability documents for regulatory submissions. You will also participate in interdepartmental project teams and present stability data to peer and management groups. In partnership with Manufacturing, Technical Operations, Supply Chain, and Research and Development, you will help conduct and resolve investigations of unexpected stability data and trends. Additional responsibilities may be assigned by the department manager.

cond_0123.intro: The incumbent will provide technical and scientific expertise in the research and development of plasma derived or recombinant proteins or in support of the manufacture of plasma derived or recombinant proteins. The incumbent is a technically competent professional who uses their expertise to assist in executing a compliant stability program to support licensed products and developmental projects, ensuring the on-going quality and safety of marketed material, in addition to implementing solutions to a variety of company related objectives. Incumbent will be responsible for providing stability support for products (marketed and/or development), generation of stability protocols and reports, reviewing and analyzing incoming data, and authoring Stability documents in support of Regulatory submissions. He/she regularly participates in interdepartmental product project teams and presents stability data to peer and management groups. In addition, he/she will work in close partnership with Manufacturing/Technical Operations/Supply Chain/Research and Development to conduct and resolve investigations of unexpected stability data and trends, staying in regular contact with these groups throughout. Additional responsibilities may be assigned by department manager.
cond_0123.responsibilities:
With supervision, develops action plans in support of departmental goals.
Executes action plans independently or as part of a team.
Capable of reporting project activities to immediate supervisor and within group meetings, actively contributing to discussions.

Independently applies sound scientific principles in development of solutions to complex technical problems within area of expertise.
Applies professional principles, established techniques, and [Company name masked]'s policies and procedures in completion of job tasks.
Assists in the design of scientifically complex experiments.
Executes and interprets results independently.
Position requires great organizational and experimental design skills.
Knowledge of the Regulatory guidelines, licensed product lines, routine test methods, and developmental projects related to stability studies.
Demonstrated ability in technical report writing and attention to detail.
Knowledge of site systems (such as SAP) to perform stability study related activities.
Able to communicate effectively and promptly, initiating contact as needed to support department objectives and management decisions.
Collects, reviews, and analyzes stability data.
Technical knowledge sufficient to conduct and resolve stability investigations is expected.
Provide support for products (marketed and/or developmental).
Provide stability support for the research and development of plasma derived proteins.
Author stability reports/documents to support the annual product reviews and regulatory submissions under direction of supervisor.
Additional Responsibilities:
Maintains work areas in accordance with [Company name masked] policies and industrial best practices.
Provides support for research and developmental studies, clinical or commercial manufacturing as needed.
Identifies, implements, and qualifies, as necessary, equipment to meet industrial best practices or achieve compliance with regulatory expectations.

cond_0144.intro: We are looking for a Senior Associate Stability Research Scientist II to join our team. The role involves providing technical and scientific expertise in the research and development of plasma derived or recombinant proteins, or in support of their manufacture. Working alongside colleagues across departments, you will help execute a compliant stability program supporting licensed products and developmental projects, ensuring the ongoing quality and safety of marketed material. Responsibilities include providing stability support for products (marketed and/or development), generating stability protocols and reports, reviewing and analyzing incoming data, and authoring stability documents in support of regulatory submissions. You will participate in interdepartmental product project teams and share stability data with peer and management groups. You will also work in partnership with Manufacturing, Technical Operations, Supply Chain, and Research and Development to coordinate and resolve investigations of unexpected stability data and trends. Additional responsibilities may be assigned by the department manager.

Incumbent will be responsible for providing stability support for products (marketed and/or development), generation of stability protocols and reports, reviewing and analyzing incoming data, and authoring Stability documents in support of Regulatory submissions. He/she may participate in interdepartmental product project teams and present stability data to peer and management groups. In addition, he/she will work in partnership with Manufacturing/Technical Operations/Supply Chain/Research and Development to conduct and resolve investigations of unexpected stability data and trends. Additional responsibilities may be assigned by department manager. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of stability data and how it connects to regulatory and product quality requirements.

The incumbent is a technically competent professional who uses their expertise to assist in executing a compliant stability program to support licensed products and developmental projects, ensuring the on-going quality and safety of marketed material, in addition to implementing solutions to a variety of company related objectives. Incumbent will be responsible for providing stability support for products (marketed and/or development), generation of stability protocols and reports, reviewing and analyzing incoming data, and authoring Stability documents in support of Regulatory submissions. He/she regularly participates in interdepartmental product project teams and presents stability data to peer and management groups. In addition, he/she will work in close partnership with Manufacturing/Technical Operations/Supply Chain/Research and Development to conduct and resolve investigations of unexpected stability data and trends. Additional responsibilities may be assigned by department manager.
cond_0222.responsibilities:
With supervision, develops action plans in support of departmental goals.
Executes action plans independently or as part of a team.
Capable of reporting project activities to immediate supervisor and within group meetings, actively contributing to discussions.
Independently prepares procedures or technical reports, including data interpretation.
With minimal supervision, prepares and clearly communicates technical results in cross-functional team settings, walking colleagues through findings and handling questions.
Independently applies sound scientific principles in development of solutions to complex technical problems within area of expertise.
Applies professional principles, established techniques, and [Company name masked]'s policies and procedures in completion of job tasks.
Assists in the design of scientifically complex experiments.
Executes and interprets results independently.
Position requires great organizational and experimental design skills.
Knowledge of the Regulatory guidelines, licensed product lines, routine test methods, and developmental projects related to stability studies.
Demonstrated ability in technical report writing and attention to detail.
Knowledge of site systems (such as SAP) to perform stability study related activities.
Able to communicate effectively and promptly with team members, supporting department objectives and management decisions.
Collects, reviews, and analyzes stability data.
Technical knowledge sufficient to conduct and resolve stability investigations is expected.
Provide support for products (marketed and/or developmental).
Provide stability support for the research and development of plasma derived proteins.
Author stability reports/documents to support the annual product reviews and regulatory submissions under direction of supervisor.
Additional Responsibilities:
Maintains work areas in accordance with [Company name masked] policies and industrial best practices.
Provides support for research and developmental studies, clinical or commercial manufacturing as needed.
Identifies, implements, and qualifies, as necessary, equipment to meet industrial best practices or achieve compliance with regulatory expectations.

cond_0229.intro: The incumbent will provide technical and scientific expertise in the research and development of plasma derived or recombinant proteins or in support of the manufacture of plasma derived or recombinant proteins. The incumbent is a technically competent professional who uses their expertise to assist in executing a compliant stability program to support licensed products and developmental projects, ensuring the on-going quality and safety of marketed material, in addition to implementing solutions to a variety of company related objectives. Incumbent will be responsible for providing stability support for products (marketed and/or development), generation of stability protocols and reports, reviewing and analyzing incoming data, and authoring Stability documents in support of Regulatory submissions. He/she may participate in interdepartmental product project teams and present stability data to peer and management groups. In addition, he/she will work in partnership with Manufacturing/Technical Operations/Supply Chain/Research and Development to conduct and resolve investigations of unexpected stability data and trends. Additional responsibilities may be assigned by department manager. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of stability data and how it connects to regulatory and product quality requirements.

cond_0235.intro: The incumbent will provide technical and scientific expertise in the research and development of plasma derived or recombinant proteins or in support of the manufacture of plasma derived or recombinant proteins. The incumbent is a technically competent professional who uses their expertise to assist in executing a compliant stability program to support licensed products and developmental projects, ensuring the on-going quality and safety of marketed material, in addition to implementing solutions to a variety of company related objectives. Incumbent will be responsible for providing stability support for products (marketed and/or development), generation of stability protocols and reports, reviewing and analyzing incoming data, and authoring Stability documents in support of Regulatory submissions. He/she may participate in interdepartmental product project teams and present stability data to peer and management groups. In addition, he/she will work in partnership with Manufacturing/Technical Operations/Supply Chain/Research and Development to conduct and resolve investigations of unexpected stability data and trends. Additional responsibilities may be assigned by department manager.

The incumbent is a technically competent professional who uses their expertise to assist in executing a compliant stability program to support licensed products and developmental projects, ensuring the on-going quality and safety of marketed material, in addition to implementing solutions to a variety of company related objectives. Incumbent will be responsible for providing stability support for products (marketed and/or development), generation of stability protocols and reports, reviewing and analyzing incoming data, and authoring Stability documents in support of Regulatory submissions. He/she regularly participates in interdepartmental product project teams and presents stability data to peer and management groups. In addition, he/she will work in close partnership with Manufacturing/Technical Operations/Supply Chain/Research and Development to conduct and resolve investigations of unexpected stability data and trends, staying in regular contact with these groups throughout. Additional responsibilities may be assigned by department manager.

The incumbent is a technically competent professional who uses their expertise to assist in executing a compliant stability program to support licensed products and developmental projects, ensuring the on-going quality and safety of marketed material, in addition to implementing solutions to a variety of company related objectives. Incumbent will be responsible for providing stability support for products (marketed and/or development), generation of stability protocols and reports, reviewing and analyzing incoming data, and authoring Stability documents in support of Regulatory submissions. He/she may participate in interdepartmental product project teams and present stability data to peer and management groups. In addition, he/she will work in partnership with Manufacturing/Technical Operations/Supply Chain/Research and Development to conduct and resolve investigations of unexpected stability data and trends. Additional responsibilities may be assigned by department manager.

cond_0345.intro: The incumbent will provide technical and scientific expertise in the research and development of plasma derived or recombinant proteins or in support of the manufacture of plasma derived or recombinant proteins. The incumbent is a technically competent professional who uses their expertise to assist in executing a compliant stability program to support licensed products and developmental projects, ensuring the on-going quality and safety of marketed material, in addition to implementing solutions to a variety of company related objectives. Incumbent will be responsible for providing stability support for products (marketed and/or development), generation of stability protocols and reports, reviewing and analyzing incoming data, and authoring Stability documents in support of Regulatory submissions. In addition, he/she will work in partnership with Manufacturing/Technical Operations/Supply Chain/Research and Development to conduct and resolve investigations of unexpected stability data and trends. cond_0351.intro: We are looking for a Senior Associate Research Scientist II to join our team. In this role, you will work alongside colleagues to support the research and development of plasma derived or recombinant proteins, or help support their manufacture. You will contribute to a compliant stability program that supports licensed products and developmental projects, helping to ensure the ongoing quality and safety of marketed material. Incumbent will be responsible for providing stability support for products (marketed and/or development), generation of stability protocols and reports, reviewing and analyzing incoming data, and authoring Stability documents in support of Regulatory submissions. He/she may participate in interdepartmental product project teams and present stability data to peer and management groups. In addition, he/she will work in partnership with Manufacturing/Technical Operations/Supply Chain/Research and Development to conduct and resolve investigations of unexpected stability data and trends. Additional responsibilities may be assigned by department manager. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with stability science and regulatory work.

Working alongside colleagues across departments, you will help execute a compliant stability program supporting licensed products and developmental projects, ensuring the ongoing quality and safety of marketed material. Responsibilities include providing stability support for products (marketed and/or development), generating stability protocols and reports, reviewing and analyzing incoming data, and authoring stability documents in support of regulatory submissions. You will participate in interdepartmental product project teams and share stability data with peer and management groups. You will also work in partnership with Manufacturing, Technical Operations, Supply Chain, and Research and Development to coordinate and resolve investigations of unexpected stability data and trends. Additional responsibilities may be assigned by the department manager.
cond_0414.responsibilities:
With supervision, coordinate action plans in support of departmental goals.
Work independently or as part of a team to carry out action plans.
Share project activity updates with your immediate supervisor and within group meetings.
Prepare procedures or technical reports, including data interpretation, with minimal direction.
With minimal supervision, prepare and communicate technical results clearly in cross-functional team settings.
Apply sound scientific principles in developing solutions to complex technical problems within your area of expertise.
Apply professional principles, established techniques, and [Company name masked]'s policies and procedures in completing job tasks.
Assist in the design of scientifically complex experiments.
Execute experiments and interpret results, coordinating with colleagues as needed.
Organizational and experimental design skills are important to this role.
Support awareness of regulatory guidelines, licensed product lines, routine test methods, and developmental projects related to stability studies.
Demonstrate ability in technical report writing with attention to detail.
Use site systems (such as SAP) to perform stability study related activities.
Communicate effectively and promptly to support department objectives and management decisions.
Collect, review, and analyze stability data together with the team.
Contribute technical knowledge to help conduct and resolve stability investigations.
Provide support for products (marketed and/or developmental).
Help support the research and development of plasma derived proteins through stability work.
Author stability reports and documents to support annual product reviews and regulatory submissions, under direction of supervisor.
Additional Responsibilities:
Maintain work areas in accordance with [Company name masked] policies and industrial best practices.
Support research and developmental studies, clinical or commercial manufacturing as needed.
Help identify, implement, and qualify equipment to meet industrial best practices or achieve compliance with regulatory expectations.
cond_0414.requirements:
The Sr Associate Stability Research Scientist II position requires no degree with a minimum of 9 years relevant experience, OR a BS in Life Sciences with a minimum of 5-6 years relevant experience, OR MS in Life Sciences with a minimum of 3 years relevant experience.
Strong working knowledge of SAP highly desirable.
Ability to set and meet deadlines, multitask, and prioritize personal tasks based on project needs.
Must have strong written and oral communication skills.
Applies scientific principles in problem solving.
Proficient with the use of MS Office software.
Work is performed in an office and a laboratory/manufacturing environment.
Exposure to biological fluids with potential exposure to infectious organisms.
Exposure to electrical office and laboratory equipment.
Personal protective equipment required such as protective eyewear, garments and gloves.
Work is performed sitting or standing for 2-4 hours per day.
Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists.

Occasionally walks, bends and twists neck and waist, may reach above or below shoulder height.

cond_0450.intro: We are looking for a Senior Associate Stability Research Scientist II to join our team. The role involves providing technical and scientific expertise in the research and development of plasma derived or recombinant proteins, or in support of their manufacture. Working alongside colleagues across departments, you will help execute a compliant stability program supporting licensed products and developmental projects, ensuring the ongoing quality and safety of marketed material. Responsibilities include providing stability support for products (marketed and/or development), generating stability protocols and reports, reviewing and analyzing incoming data, and authoring stability documents in support of regulatory submissions. You will participate in interdepartmental product project teams and share stability data with peer and management groups. You will also work in partnership with Manufacturing, Technical Operations, Supply Chain, and Research and Development to coordinate and resolve investigations of unexpected stability data and trends. Additional responsibilities may be assigned by the department manager.
cond_0450.responsibilities:
With supervision, coordinate action plans in support of departmental goals.
Work independently or as part of a team to carry out action plans.
Share project activity updates with your immediate supervisor and within group meetings.
Prepare procedures or technical reports, including data interpretation, with minimal direction.
With minimal supervision, prepare and communicate technical results clearly in cross-functional team settings.
Apply sound scientific principles in developing solutions to complex technical problems within your area of expertise.
Apply professional principles, established techniques, and [Company name masked]'s policies and procedures in completing job tasks.
Assist in the design of scientifically complex experiments.
Execute experiments and interpret results, coordinating with colleagues as needed.
Organizational and experimental design skills are important to this role.
Support awareness of regulatory guidelines, licensed product lines, routine test methods, and developmental projects related to stability studies.
Demonstrate ability in technical report writing with attention to detail.
Use site systems (such as SAP) to perform stability study related activities.
Communicate effectively and promptly to support department objectives and management decisions.
Collect, review, and analyze stability data together with the team.
Contribute technical knowledge to help conduct and resolve stability investigations.
Provide support for products (marketed and/or developmental).
Help support the research and development of plasma derived proteins through stability work.
Author stability reports and documents to support annual product reviews and regulatory submissions, under direction of supervisor.
Additional Responsibilities:
Maintain work areas in accordance with [Company name masked] policies and industrial best practices.
Support research and developmental studies, clinical or commercial manufacturing as needed.
Help identify, implement, and qualify equipment to meet industrial best practices or achieve compliance with regulatory expectations.

The Sr Associate Stability Research Scientist II position requires no degree with a minimum of 9 years relevant experience, OR a BS in Life Sciences with a minimum of 5-6 years relevant experience, OR MS in Life Sciences with a minimum of 3 years relevant experience.

You will contribute to a compliant stability program that supports licensed products and developmental projects, helping to ensure the ongoing quality and safety of marketed material. Working together with cross-functional partners, you will help implement solutions to a range of objectives. You will share responsibility for stability support, generating protocols and reports, reviewing and analyzing incoming data, and co-authoring stability documents for regulatory submissions. You will also participate in interdepartmental project teams and present stability data to peer and management groups. In partnership with Manufacturing, Technical Operations, Supply Chain, and Research and Development, you will help conduct and resolve investigations of unexpected stability data and trends. Additional responsibilities may be assigned by the department manager.
cond_0477.responsibilities:
With supervision, help develop action plans in support of departmental goals.
Execute action plans independently or in coordination with team members.
Report project activities to your immediate supervisor and within group meetings.
Prepare procedures or technical reports, including data interpretation, with input from the team as needed.
With minimal supervision, prepare and communicate technical results clearly in cross-functional team settings.
Apply sound scientific principles in collaboration with colleagues to develop solutions to complex technical problems within your area of expertise.
Apply professional principles, established techniques, and [Company name masked]'s policies and procedures in completing job tasks.
Assist in the design of scientifically complex experiments.
Execute and interpret results, sharing findings with the team.
Contribute strong organizational and experimental design skills to support team efforts.
Maintain working knowledge of regulatory guidelines, licensed product lines, routine test methods, and developmental projects related to stability studies.
Prepare technical reports with attention to detail.
Use site systems (such as SAP) to support stability study related activities.
Communicate effectively and promptly to support department objectives and management decisions.
Collect, review, and analyze stability data in coordination with colleagues.
Contribute technical knowledge to help conduct and resolve stability investigations.
Support products (marketed and/or developmental) alongside the broader team.
Help support the research and development of plasma derived proteins through stability work.
Author stability reports and documents to support annual product reviews and regulatory submissions, under the direction of your supervisor.
Additional Responsibilities:
Maintain work areas in accordance with [Company name masked] policies and industrial best practices.
Support research and developmental studies, clinical or commercial manufacturing as needed, working alongside relevant teams.
Help identify, implement, and qualify equipment to meet industrial best practices or achieve compliance with regulatory expectations.

Ability to set and meet deadlines, multitask, and prioritize tasks based on project needs.

The incumbent is a technically competent professional who uses their expertise to assist in executing a compliant stability program to support licensed products and developmental projects, ensuring the on-going quality and safety of marketed material, in addition to implementing solutions to a variety of company related objectives. Incumbent will be responsible for providing stability support for products (marketed and/or development), generation of stability protocols and reports, reviewing and analyzing incoming data, and authoring Stability documents in support of Regulatory submissions. He/she regularly participates in interdepartmental product project teams and presents stability data to peer and management groups. In addition, he/she will work in close partnership with Manufacturing/Technical Operations/Supply Chain/Research and Development to conduct and resolve investigations of unexpected stability data and trends, staying in regular contact with these groups throughout. Additional responsibilities may be assigned by department manager.
cond_0519.responsibilities:
With supervision, develops action plans in support of departmental goals.
Executes action plans independently or as part of a team.
Capable of reporting project activities to immediate supervisor and within group meetings, actively contributing to discussions.
Independently prepares procedures or technical reports, including data interpretation.
With minimal supervision, prepares and clearly communicates technical results in cross-functional team settings, walking stakeholders through findings and handling questions as they arise.
Independently applies sound scientific principles in development of solutions to complex technical problems within area of expertise.
Applies professional principles, established techniques, and [Company name masked]'s policies and procedures in completion of job tasks.
Assists in the design of scientifically complex experiments.
Executes and interprets results independently.
Position requires great organizational and experimental design skills.
Knowledge of the Regulatory guidelines, licensed product lines, routine test methods, and developmental projects related to stability studies.
Demonstrated ability in technical report writing and attention to detail.
Knowledge of site systems (such as SAP) to perform stability study related activities.
Able to communicate effectively and promptly, initiating contact as needed to support department objectives and management decisions.
Collects, reviews, and analyzes stability data.
Technical knowledge sufficient to conduct and resolve stability investigations is expected.
Provide support for products (marketed and/or developmental).
Provide stability support for the research and development of plasma derived proteins.
Author stability reports/documents to support the annual product reviews and regulatory submissions under direction of supervisor.
Additional Responsibilities:
Maintains work areas in accordance with [Company name masked] policies and industrial best practices.
Provides support for research and developmental studies, clinical or commercial manufacturing as needed.
Identifies, implements, and qualifies, as necessary, equipment to meet industrial best practices or achieve compliance with regulatory expectations.

Ability to set and meet deadlines, multitask, and prioritize personal tasks based on project needs.

Applies scientific principles in problem solving.
Proficient with the use of MS Office software.

The Sr Associate Stability Research Scientist II position requires no degree with a minimum of 9 years relevant experience, OR a BS in Life Sciences with a minimum of 5-6 years relevant experience, OR MS in Life Sciences with a minimum of 3 years relevant experience.

cond_0570.intro: The incumbent will provide technical and scientific expertise in the research and development of plasma derived or recombinant proteins or in support of the manufacture of plasma derived or recombinant proteins. The incumbent is a technically competent professional who uses their expertise to assist in executing a compliant stability program to support licensed products and developmental projects, ensuring the on-going quality and safety of marketed material, in addition to implementing solutions to a variety of company related objectives. Incumbent will be responsible for providing stability support for products (marketed and/or development), generation of stability protocols and reports, reviewing and analyzing incoming data, and authoring Stability documents in support of Regulatory submissions. He/she may participate in interdepartmental product project teams and present stability data to peer and management groups. In addition, he/she will work in partnership with Manufacturing/Technical Operations/Supply Chain/Research and Development to conduct and resolve investigations of unexpected stability data and trends. Additional responsibilities may be assigned by department manager.
cond_0570.responsibilities:
With supervision, develops action plans in support of departmental goals.

With minimal supervision, prepares and effectively communicates technical results in cross-functional team settings.
Independently applies sound scientific principles in development of solutions to complex technical problems within area of expertise.
Applies professional principles, established techniques, and [Company name masked]'s policies and procedures in completion of job tasks.
Assists in the design of scientifically complex experiments.
Executes and interprets results independently.
Position requires great organizational and experimental design skills.
Knowledge of the Regulatory guidelines, licensed product lines, routine test methods, and developmental projects related to stability studies.
Demonstrated ability in technical report writing and attention to detail.
Knowledge of site systems (such as SAP) to perform stability study related activities.
Able to communicate effectively and promptly supporting department objectives and management decisions.
Collects, reviews, and analyzes stability data.
Technical knowledge sufficient to conduct and resolve stability investigations is expected.
Provide support for products (marketed and/or developmental).
Provide stability support for the research and development of plasma derived proteins.
Author stability reports/documents to support the annual product reviews and regulatory submissions under direction of supervisor.

Incumbent will be responsible for providing stability support for products (marketed and/or development), generation of stability protocols and reports, reviewing and analyzing incoming data, and authoring Stability documents in support of Regulatory submissions. He/she may participate in interdepartmental product project teams and present stability data to peer and management groups. In addition, he/she will work in partnership with Manufacturing/Technical Operations/Supply Chain/Research and Development to conduct and resolve investigations of unexpected stability data and trends. Additional responsibilities may be assigned by department manager.

cond_0612.intro: We are looking for a Senior Associate Stability Research Scientist II to join our team. The role involves providing technical and scientific expertise in the research and development of plasma derived or recombinant proteins, or in support of their manufacture. Working alongside colleagues across departments, you will help execute a compliant stability program supporting licensed products and developmental projects, ensuring the ongoing quality and safety of marketed material. Responsibilities include providing stability support for products (marketed and/or development), generating stability protocols and reports, reviewing and analyzing incoming data, and authoring stability documents in support of regulatory submissions. You will participate in interdepartmental product project teams and share stability data with peer and management groups. You will also work in partnership with Manufacturing, Technical Operations, Supply Chain, and Research and Development to coordinate and resolve investigations of unexpected stability data and trends.
